title: Garlic Butter Shrimp Pasta
description: Juicy shrimp tossed with spaghetti in a glossy garlic butter and lemon sauce. A restaurant-style dinner on the table in about 25 minutes.

ingredients.note: plus more for the pasta water

steps: Bring a large pot of well-salted water to a boil. Cook the spaghetti 1 minute less than the package time, then reserve 1 cup of pasta water and drain.
While the pasta cooks, pat the shrimp dry and season with the kosher salt.
Heat the olive oil and 1 tbsp of the butter in a 12-inch skillet over medium-high heat. Add the shrimp in one layer and cook 1 to 2 minutes per side, just until pink and opaque. Move them to a plate.
Lower the heat to medium. Add the remaining 3 tbsp butter, the garlic and red pepper flakes, and cook 30 to 60 seconds, stirring, until fragrant but not browned.

Add the drained spaghetti, 1/2 cup reserved pasta water and the lemon juice. Toss for 1 to 2 minutes until the sauce turns glossy and coats the pasta, adding a splash more pasta water if it looks dry.
Return the shrimp to the pan, add the Parmesan and parsley, and toss for 30 seconds to warm through. Taste, adjust salt, and serve right away.
tips: Shrimp cook fast: pull them as soon as they turn opaque, they finish in the sauce.
Swap spaghetti for linguine or fettuccine.
storage: Keeps 2 days in an airtight container in the fridge. Reheat gently with a splash of water.

video_script.hook: Garlic butter shrimp pasta with 32 grams of protein, in twenty-five minutes.
steps_short: Cook the spaghetti and save a cup of pasta water.
Sear the shrimp in butter, one to two minutes a side.
Melt more butter with garlic and chili flakes.
Toss in the pasta, pasta water and lemon juice.
Add the shrimp, Parmesan and parsley. Done.
